card.title: Careful Around the Scar
card.instruction: Treat one harmless detail as the trigger for an old hurt. Become overly careful, helpful, or controlled whenever it returns.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Could you move that yellow envelope away from my birthday cake?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's a voucher from your sister.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Lovely. My eviction notice came in yellow. I'll find her a nicer envelope.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll take the voucher out and bin this one.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Thank you. Under the coffee grounds, please. I'll hold the lid.
